text_block_list.text:
I will bring Air Groove back to life. To 
do that, I need a chance to talk to her.

I hadn't sorted out my thoughts into words 
yet. Even so, I called Air Groove over, 
telling her, "I just really need to talk—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—What is the meaning of this? Calling me 
out to a place like this.
choice_data_list: I want to open your eyes.
I want to wake you up to the truth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list: Weren't you going to surpass Suzuka?
Weren't you going to surpass Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. I have to surpass Suzuka. 
And yet――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I am— for the first time, afraid."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"At Suzuka's running— and at myself, 
unable to imagine ever surpassing it...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka's running moves everyone's 
hearts precisely because it is faster and 
freer than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Precisely because I ran alongside her, 
I can understand. That free, innocent 
running of Suzuka's is, for many 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...that it had become an "admiration."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand... Look at how I am 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To become the ideal for all Umamusume, I 
have kept running forward as the 
"Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yet, at this point... can that really be 
said to mean anything anymore?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In fact... Suzuka is right here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Enthraling many and giving them dreams— an 
Umamusume who embodies everyone's "ideal" 
already exists.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"At this point... someone like me has 
nothingâ"
choice_data_list: You and Suzuka should be different.
You and Suzuka should be different.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――Wrong?
choice_data_list:
There must be something only Air Groove 
can demonstrate.

There must be something only Air Groove 
can demonstrate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because of me...?

Up until today, I've walked alongside Air 
Groove. I've watched her words and actions 
up close all this time...

Because I was closest to her— Because I 
was captivated by her running more than 
anyone else—

Because I am who I am, there are words I 
can share with Air Groove right now.
Yes, "Air Groove" surely means—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The Challenger—

I told Air Groove about everything I had 
seen in her up to this point...

—I will become the 'ideal' of every 
Umamusume.

From the very beginning, Air Groove had 
been continuously challenging that 
seemingly impossible dream.

To always remain an "ideal" no matter the 
circumstance, she disciplined herself and 
kept looking forward—

Sometimes guiding the academy as student 
council vice president, sometimes 
mentoring underclassmen as a senior, she 
has continued to run the Twinkle Series to 
this very day.

I, too... and all the other Umamusume at 
the academy, had been watching her the 
entire time.

In the Hanshin JF, in the Triple Tiara... 
Never yielding, never giving up, never 
looking back—

As the "Empress," full of pride... I have 
continued to challenge the odds toward my 
dream.

"Never let your guard down." "I will aim 
for even greater heights."
"Which is why you too—had better keep up."

Saying so, pushing ever forward to take on 
the next challenge—that is truly the 
"Empress," Air Groove.

The ideal that every Umamusume should 
strive toward— the figure of an 
indomitable "Challenger"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So that is how I... appeared to you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ――It is not just him.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ――It is not just her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at you in that way... was true 
for me as well."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The reason I came here is because 
there is something I want to show you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Follow me.

The place Symboli Rudolf led me to was the 
beach being used as a practice ground for 
the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not yet... even more...!

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: T-This is so brutal~~!

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it insane that Air Groove-senpai was 
doing this routine last year!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why. If I'm aiming for 
her— I have to work even harder than she 
does...!"

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...You can say that again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Hey~, Dober! Are you still at it!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You've been working super hard lately, 
but... don't push yourself too hard. Are 
you doing okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for worrying about me. But 
I'm not overdoing it, I'm just—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's a "challenge."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...To my very limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back in a little bit... See ya 
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Everyone, we're not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oooh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Watching Dober might've rubbed 
off on me a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! Let me join in too! I want to push 
my muscles to the limit together!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Did you understand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What they are chasing after... is the 
"Empress," Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The way you have fought as a "challenger" 
up until now— it has become their "ideal."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if hardships lie ahead on their path, 
the "ideal" that is you will help them 
rise again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With their own legs, just like that... 
they will surely challenge themselves, 
aiming for glory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...It is now, as Tracen Academy's Student 
Council President, that I wish to express 
my deepest gratitude to you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for guiding them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I shall take my leave here. I leave the 
rest to you and Air Groove—

After Symboli Rudolf left the area, a 
brief silence fell. What words should I 
offer Air Groove now—
choice_data_list: I'll keep taking on new challenges.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter how high and difficult the wall 
that stands in my way, I will continue to 
challenge it without fear—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is what I can show...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nay. It is the "ideal" that I have 
demonstrated...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To be the 'ideal' everyone hopes for... I 
want to challenge Suzuka one more time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now that's my trainer.

The rematch against Silence Suzuka begins 
here...!

First, I must mount my comeback at the 
Sapporo Kinen and prove that the "Empress" 
is still alive and well!
